items.t: A 72-Year-Old With $1,000,000 in Comcast, Noble and First Interstate BancSystem Collects $4,323 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA $1,000,000 portfolio split evenly across Comcast, Noble and First Interstate BancSystem pays about $51,900 a year in dividends at today’s prices. Comcast’s dividend took 24% of its free cash flow over the last 12 months, and First Interstate’s took 64% of its normalized earnings in fiscal 2025.
